# Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library — Archipelago

An [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) randomizer for **Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!**

The mod locks the game's 400 book series and 31 sections behind items. Shelving books sends checks. Items from the multiworld unlock more books and bookcases.

## What you need

- [Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4197610/Librarian_Tidy_Up_the_Arcane_Library/) on Steam (game 1.0.12 or 1.0.13).
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases) 0.6.4 or newer.
- UE4SS (experimental build). It is bundled in the release zip, so you do not download it.

## Install

The game folder is `Librarian Tidy Up the Arcane Library!` in your Steam `steamapps/common` folder.

1. Open the [latest release](../../releases/latest) and download both files: `Librarian-AP_v<version>.zip` and `librarian.apworld`.
2. Extract the zip anywhere. It holds a `Librarian/` folder.
3. Drag `Librarian/` onto the game folder. Say yes to merge.
4. Copy `librarian.apworld` into `custom_worlds/` in your Archipelago folder.
5. Steam Deck or Linux only: add a launch option. See [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#steam-deck-and-linux-proton).

Upgrading: do the same steps. The zip carries a blank `ap_config.json`, so merging replaces your saved server and slot. Back up `Mods/Librarian-AP/Scripts/ap_config.json` first if you want them back, or type them in again. Replace `librarian.apworld` too. Seeds made with 3.0.2 keep working with 3.0.3; regenerate any seed you have not started yet.

Where the files land:

- `Librarian/Binaries/Win64/Mods/Librarian-AP/` (the mod and `Scripts/ap_config.json`)
- `Librarian/Content/Paks/LogicMods/LibrarianAPHUDFix.pak`

## Play

1. Restart Archipelago. Click **Generate Template Options** and open `Librarian Tidy Up the Arcane Library.yaml`.
2. Set `name: Player1` and any options you want. Put the file in `Players/`.
3. Click **Generate**. Host the `.archipelago` file, or upload it.
4. Start the game. The Archipelago Connection menu opens at the title screen. Press **F4** to show or hide it.
5. Enter the server (for example `localhost:38281`), your slot name (`Player1`) and the password, if any. Click **Connect**.
6. The mod starts or loads the run for you. Wait 10 to 20 seconds while the shelves are set up.
7. Shelve books. Checks go out, items come in. When you reach your goal, the way out opens. Walk to the door.

Handy keys: **F8** shows what is left, **F9** reconnects with your saved details.

## Logs

The mod writes one log per launch to `Librarian/Binaries/Win64/Mods/Librarian-AP/logs/`. With a bug report, send the newest log file and your YAML.

## Known issues

- A BookSanity check can lag a moment behind the book that earned it. Pick the book up and place it again.
- A hidden book can turn invisible when you pick it up. Reload, or throw it out of bounds.

More in [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).

## More

- [Options](docs/OPTIONS.md): every YAML option
- [Logic and rules](docs/LOGIC.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)

## Librarian-AP v3.0.2

Traps, a higher spare book percent for custom goals, and four fixes.

**Existing runs keep working.** Install over 3.0.1 and reconnect. The end door fix works
on a run in progress; the other three fixes and the new options need a seed generated with
the new apworld. A 3.0.1 YAML still works, but see the trap note below.

## New: traps

Traps are items that make things harder for a short while. They take the place of filler,
never of anything a check or your goal depends on, and nothing a trap does is saved into
your game.

**Traps are on by default.** A YAML that says nothing about them gets about 10% of its
filler turned into traps, and that includes a 3.0.1 YAML regenerated with the new apworld.
Set `trap_percentage: 0` for a seed with none.

```yaml
trap_percentage: 10   # 0-100, default 10
trap_weights:         # how often each one comes up; 0 turns it off
  Fatigue: 2
  Floor Shuffle: 2
  Veil: 2
  Butterfingers: 2
  Scramble Shelf: 1
  Shelf Spill: 1
```

| Trap | What it does |
|---|---|
| Fatigue | One magic skill recovers slowly for two minutes. |
| Floor Shuffle | The loose books lying on the floor swap places with each other. |
| Veil | The loose books you could pick up are hidden for 30 seconds, then come back. |
| Butterfingers | Some of the books in your hands, from one up to all of them, fall beside you in a pile. |
| Scramble Shelf | A few books in a row you have not finished trade places. |
| Shelf Spill | A few books in a row you have not finished fall out onto the floor in front of their bookcase. |

The shelf traps never touch a finished row, so a completed row and its check stay done.
Their notice says which bookcase and row they hit, for example "Scramble Shelf: 2 books on
bookcase 2J, row 1 are out of order", and says so when one is skipped because you are
carrying books or the shelves are empty.
A notice shows on screen when a trap takes effect. In the multiworld the items end in
"Trap", for example `Veil Trap` and `Sort Fatigue Trap`.

**Fatigue changed.** In 3.0.1 every seed had a fixed set of up to ten Fatigue items. Fatigue
is now one of the traps above, so how many you get follows `trap_percentage` and its weight.

## New: higher `spare_book_item_percent` on custom goals

```yaml
spare_book_item_percent: 10   # 0-100, default 10
```

The range goes up to 100. Past 20 it only works on `goal: custom`, and only when the host
allows it (`allow_high_spare_book_percent` in `host.yaml`, off by default). Other goals are
held at 20.

## Fix: you could leave through the end door before your goal

Once every book you had unlocked was shelved, the game let you leave through the library
door and play the ending before your Archipelago goal was reached. The door now stays shut
until the goal is reached.

## Fix: individual book unlocks with count checks never showed any books

With `unlock_mode: individual_book_unlocks` and `check_mode: count`, the books you received
never appeared. Seeds generated with the new apworld reveal them as they arrive.

## Fix: booksanity milestones were in logic from the start

With `check_mode: booksanity`, the "Correctly shelve N books" checks (with series unlocks) and,
on floor and custom goals, the Reached Level checks past what the seed's rows can reach were in
logic from the start, so the tracker showed them early and items could be placed on them out
of reach. New seeds gate them by the books and rows you can actually shelve.

## Fix: random book bundles all came from the two starting sections

With `unlock_mode: random_book_bundle` and `bookcase_unlocks: unlocked`, the first bundles
all came from the two starting sections instead of from across the library. Seeds generated
with the new apworld draw every bundle from the whole library.

## Updating

> Extract the zip and drop `Librarian/` into your Steam install (overwrite). Drop
> `librarian.apworld` into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` folder. **Both are required.**
> The title screen should read `LibAP v3.0.2`.

## If something breaks

Press F8, then send that session's log from `Mods\Librarian-AP\logs\`, your YAML's
`Librarian:` section, and one line on what you were doing.
